recipes.title: Pakistani Chicken Karahi
steps: Fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, chilies, spices and salt.
Cook uncovered, stirring, for 15 minutes until the tomatoes break down and the oil separates.
Stir in the yogurt and garam masala for 3 minutes and finish with cilantro and julienned ginger.

recipes.title: Nepali Chicken Momos
steps: Knead the flour and water to a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, cilantro, cumin, soy and salt.
Roll small thin rounds, fill and pleat closed.
Steam on oiled parchment for 12 minutes.
Blend the roasted tomatoes and chili with salt for the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Cook the beef with the soy sauce and half the sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts and season each with sesame oil and salt; quickly saute the carrot, zucchini and mushrooms separately.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef on top, add an egg and serve with gochujang and sesame; mix everything before eating.

recipes.title: Korean Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until it renders, then add the kimchi and fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in the gochugaru and gochujang, add the water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Add green onions and sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Oyakodon
steps: Simmer the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar in a small frying pan, add the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer for 6 minutes until cooked.
Pour over the eggs in a circle, cover and cook for 1 minute until just set.
Slide over bowls of rice and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, then add the onion, potatoes and carrots and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar, bring to a simmer and skim.
Cover with a smaller lid resting on the food and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha
steps: Mix the pork with half the fish sauce, the sugar, shallots and garlic and shape into small patties; rest 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side until charred.
Warm the nuoc cham with a splash of water and the carrot.
Serve the patties in bowls of the sauce with noodles, lettuce and herbs alongside for dipping.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
steps: Melt the sugar in a heavy pot until deep amber, then carefully add the pork and stir to coat.
Add the fish sauce, shallots, garlic and coconut water, bring to a simmer and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the sauce is sticky.
Season with pepper and scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Gai
steps: Cook the chicken in a dry pan with 3 tbsp water, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until just cooked.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, lime juice and chili.
Add the rice powder, shallots and herbs and toss.
Serve warm or at room temperature with lettuce cups.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic, chili and shrimp paste in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, kecap manis and soy and stir-fry over high heat for 4 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil and serve on top with cucumber and fried shallots.

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Tinola
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and fish sauce and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the water and simmer for 20 minutes, skimming.
Add the papaya and simmer 8 minutes until tender, then the spinach for 1 minute; season with pepper.

recipes.title: Filipino Pancit Bihon
steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for 10 minutes and drain.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil, then the chicken for 4 minutes.
Add the carrot, cabbage and snow peas for 2 minutes, then the soy and stock and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid; serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Poke Bowls
steps: Toss the tuna with the soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, green onions and sesame seeds; chill for 15 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the tuna, avocado, cucumber and nori. Use only fish sold for eating raw.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo Tofu
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until crisp, then the bean paste, black beans, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock and slide in the tofu; simmer for 5 minutes without stirring too much.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground peppercorns and green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble softly in 1 tbsp hot oil; tip out while still wet.
Add the rest of the oil and the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until juicy, with the sugar, ketchup and salt.
Return the eggs and fold through.
Scatter with green onions and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Bowl
steps: Cook the grain in salted water according to the packet and drain or fluff.

Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Toss the vegetables that need cooking with the oil, any spice and salt and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once (keep cucumber, cabbage, leaves and fresh tomatoes raw).
Cook or warm the protein: pan-fry tofu, tempeh, chicken or shrimp until golden and cooked through; just rinse and drain canned beans.
Whisk the dressing ingredients with a splash of water and salt to taste.
Build the bowls: grain first, then the vegetables and protein, a spoonful of dressing and the toppings.

steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the vegetables with half the oil, salt and pepper and spread them out in one layer; roast for 15 minutes first if they are potatoes or root vegetables.
Toss the protein with the rest of the oil and the seasoning, add it to the pan and roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through (chicken to 74 °C / 165 °F).
Finish with any lemon, sauce, cheese or herbs from the list and serve straight from the pan.

Beat the eggs with salt and pour into the pan, stirring gently until just set underneath.
Add the filling and cheese to one half, fold and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Eggs Benedict

ingredients.name: Eggs, 4 to poach and 3 yolks for the sauce

steps: Whisk the yolks with 1 tbsp lemon juice over barely simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in the melted butter for hollandaise; season.
Warm the bacon.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Stack muffin, bacon and egg and spoon over the hollandaise.

steps: Fry the sweet potato in the oil, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and paprika and cook uncovered for 8 minutes until browned.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes.
Season and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Everything Seasoning
steps: Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Spread on the warm toast.
Sprinkle with the seasoning and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Chia Seed Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia, coconut milk, maple syrup and vanilla.
Leave 10 minutes and whisk again to break up clumps.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Top with berries.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal with Egg
steps: Simmer the oats in the stock for 5 minutes until creamy.
Fry or soft-boil the egg.
Top the oats with the egg, soy sauce, green onion and chili crisp.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes (Syrniki)

ingredients.name: Cottage cheese, or farmer cheese, drained

steps: Mix the cheese, egg, flour, sugar and vanilla.
Shape into 10 small patties and dust with flour.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with sour cream and jam.

recipes.title: Japanese Tamagoyaki
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar, soy and mirin.
Oil a small pan and pour in a thin layer; when nearly set roll it to one end.
Add another layer, lifting the roll so egg flows under, and roll again; repeat.
Rest the roll for 2 minutes and slice.

recipes.title: Mexican Chilaquiles Rojos
steps: Simmer the sauce in a wide pan.
Add the chips and toss for 1 minute so they soften slightly.
Top with fried eggs, cheese, sour cream, onion and cilantro.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Full English Breakfast
steps: Fry the sausages for 12 to 15 minutes, adding the bacon for the last 6.
Fry the tomatoes and mushrooms in the fat.
Warm the beans and fry the eggs.
Toast or fry the bread and serve everything together.

recipes.title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in 150 ml|heavy cream and heat gently without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with chives.

recipes.title: Avgolemono (Greek Lemon Chicken Soup)
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with dill.

recipes.title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Wakame
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 3 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with green onions.

recipes.title: Tom Yum Soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 10 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vichyssoise
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 25 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in 200 ml|heavy cream and heat gently without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with chives (serve chilled).

recipes.title: Sopa de Lima
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with tortilla strips and cilantro.

recipes.title: Harira
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 35 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Peanut Soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with chopped peanuts and cilantro.

recipes.title: Leek and White Bean Soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in 1|lemon and heat gently without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with olive oil and black pepper.

recipes.title: Spicy Sausage and Kale Soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil (or the butter) in a large pot and cook the aromatics, chopped, over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft (stir in any flour or spices for the last minute).
Add the vegetables and the liquid, bring to the boil, then simmer for about 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (whisk any egg or egg-lemon mixture with a ladle of hot broth first, and stir in cornstarch mixed with a little water) and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Carrots with Thyme
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 230 °C (450 °F).
Lay the boiled potatoes on an oiled tray and press each one flat with the bottom of a glass.
Brush with oil, scatter with garlic, rosemary and salt and roast for 30 minutes until very crisp.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: Balsamic Roasted Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Green Beans
steps: Heat the oil (or butter) in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetables with any garlic or shallot and cook, tossing, for about 8 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the remaining flavourings, season and serve.

recipes.title: Charred Corn with Lime Butter
steps: Heat a grill or griddle pan to high.
Brush the vegetables with a little oil and season.
Grill for about 12 minutes, turning, until charred in places.
Finish with the remaining flavourings.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Sesame Bok Choy
steps: Heat the oil (or butter) in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetables with any garlic or shallot and cook, tossing, for about 5 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the remaining flavourings, season and serve.

recipes.title: Mexican Street-Style Zucchini
steps: Heat a grill or griddle pan to high.
Brush the vegetables with a little oil and season.
Grill for about 8 minutes, turning, until charred in places.
Finish with the remaining flavourings.

recipes.title: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas and Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Roasted Delicata Squash
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Glazed Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Okra and Tomatoes
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook any onion or garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the remaining flavourings with 4 tbsp water, cover and simmer gently for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Uncover to reduce any liquid and season.

recipes.title: Roasted Radishes with Herbs
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Elote-Style Corn Salad Side
steps: Heat the oil (or butter) in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetables with any garlic or shallot and cook, tossing, for about 8 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the remaining flavourings, season and serve.

recipes.title: Herbed Couscous
steps: Pour 300 ml boiling salted water over the couscous with 1 tbsp oil, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Stir in the herbs, lemon juice and zest, and almonds, and season.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Rice Pilaf
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, add the stock and salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon zest, juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oil (or butter) in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetables with any garlic or shallot and cook, tossing, for about 10 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the remaining flavourings, season and serve.

recipes.title: Turmeric Roasted Cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, salt, pepper and any dry spices or herbs and spread in a single layer on a large tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Toss with the remaining flavourings and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dressing
steps: Whisk everything together until smooth.
Thin with a little water if you want to drizzle it.
Keeps 1 week chilled.

recipes.title: Creamy Ranch Dressing
steps: Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise and sour cream.
Stir in the herbs, garlic and onion powder and season.
Chill for 30 minutes so the flavours develop.

recipes.title: Caesar Dressing
steps: Mash the anchovies and garlic to a paste.
Whisk in the yolk, lemon juice and mustard, then the oil in a thin stream.
Stir in the parmesan and pepper; use within 2 days because of the raw yolk.

recipes.title: Balsamic Glaze
steps: Simmer the vinegar and sugar in a small pan for 12 to 15 minutes until reduced by about half.
It thickens more as it cools; stop when it coats a spoon.
Cool and store in a jar.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Verde
steps: Mix the parsley, oregano, garlic and pepper flakes.
Stir in the vinegar, oil and salt.
Rest for 20 minutes before spooning over grilled meat or vegetables.

recipes.title: Peanut Satay Sauce
steps: Warm everything in a small pan over low heat, whisking, until smooth.
Simmer 2 minutes, then add lime juice.
Thin with water to taste.

recipes.title: Tzatziki Sauce
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry in a towel.
Mix with the yogurt, garlic, dill, oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Season and chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Sauce
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water and simmer until glossy.
Cool; keeps 2 weeks chilled.

recipes.title: Enchilada Sauce
steps: Cook the flour in the oil for 1 minute, then the spices for 30 seconds.
Whisk in the tomato paste and stock.
Simmer 10 minutes until slightly thick and season.

recipes.title: Bechamel Sauce
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk gradually and simmer, whisking, for 5 minutes until thick.
Season with nutmeg and salt.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Crema
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Season with salt.
Keeps 4 days chilled.

recipes.title: Raita
steps: Squeeze the cucumber lightly.
Stir into the yogurt with the cumin and mint.
Season and chill.

recipes.title: Mint Chutney
steps: Blend the herbs, chili, ginger and lemon juice with 2 tbsp water to a paste.
Stir in the yogurt.
Season with salt.

recipes.title: Tamarind Date Chutney
steps: Simmer the dates, tamarind and jaggery in the water for 10 minutes.
Blend smooth with the spices.
Simmer 3 minutes more to thicken and cool.

recipes.title: Chili Crisp Oil
steps: Fry the shallots in the oil over medium heat until golden, about 8 minutes, then the garlic for 2 minutes.
Put the chili flakes, peppercorns, sesame, sugar and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Pour the hot oil and crispy bits over, stir and cool; keep the jar refrigerated.

recipes.title: Gochujang Sauce
steps: Whisk everything together until smooth.
Thin with water if needed.
Use for bibimbap, noodles or as a dip.

recipes.title: Blender Hot Sauce
steps: Simmer the chilies, carrot and garlic in the vinegar for 10 minutes.
Blend until very smooth with the salt and sugar.
Pour into a clean bottle and refrigerate; wear gloves when handling hot chilies.

recipes.title: Barbecue Dry Rub
steps: Mix everything well.
Store in a jar for up to 3 months.
Rub generously onto meat 1 hour (or overnight) before cooking.

recipes.title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
steps: Mix everything in a jar.
Use about 2 tbsp per 500 g of meat or beans with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Relish
steps: Simmer everything until the cranberries pop and the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Cool; it thickens further in the fridge.

recipes.title: Iced Green Tea with Mint
steps: Steep the tea in 500 ml water at about 80 °C for 3 minutes, then remove the bags.
Stir in the honey and mint and add the rest of the water, cold.
Chill and serve over ice with lemon.

recipes.title: Agua Fresca de Sandia
steps: Blend the watermelon with the water, lime juice and sugar.
Strain if you like it smooth.
Serve over ice with mint.

recipes.title: Iced Coffee Latte
steps: Fill two glasses with ice.
Pour in the coffee and maple syrup and stir.
Top with cold milk.

recipes.title: Dalgona Whipped Coffee
steps: Whisk the coffee, sugar and hot water hard for 3 to 4 minutes until thick and pale.
Fill glasses with ice and milk.
Spoon the whipped coffee on top.

recipes.title: Thai Iced Tea
steps: Simmer the tea and star anise in the water for 5 minutes, then strain.
Stir in the sugar and cool.
Pour over ice and float the condensed milk on top.

recipes.title: Hibiscus Iced Tea (Agua de Jamaica)
steps: Boil the hibiscus in 500 ml water for 5 minutes and steep 15 minutes.
Strain, stir in the sugar and add the rest of the water.
Chill and serve over ice with lime.

recipes.title: Ginger Lemon Honey Tea
steps: Simmer the ginger in the water for 5 minutes.
Pour into mugs with lemon juice and honey.

recipes.title: Cucumber Mint Cooler
steps: Blend the cucumber, mint, lime juice and honey with 200 ml water and strain.
Pour over ice and top with sparkling water.

recipes.title: Strawberry Lemonade Slush
steps: Blend everything until slushy.
Taste and add more sugar or lemon.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Sweet Lassi
steps: Blend everything until frothy.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

recipes.title: Salted Mint Lassi
steps: Blend everything until frothy.
Season with salt and serve cold.

recipes.title: Mulled Wine
steps: Warm the wine with the orange, spices and sugar over low heat for 20 minutes without boiling.
Stir in the brandy if using.
Strain and serve warm.

recipes.title: Banana Date Shake
steps: Blend everything until thick and smooth.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Cold Brew Coffee
steps: Stir the coffee into the cold water in a jar.
Cover and leave at room temperature for 12 to 18 hours.
Strain through a paper filter; dilute 1:1 with water or milk and keep chilled up to a week.

recipes.title: Pineapple Ginger Juice
steps: Blend the pineapple, ginger, lime juice and water.
Strain through a sieve, pressing.
Sweeten and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Moroccan Mint Tea
steps: Rinse the tea with a little boiling water and discard the water.
Add the mint, sugar and fresh boiling water and steep for 4 minutes.
Pour from a height into small glasses.

recipes.title: Apple Carrot Ginger Juice
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Bean Dip
steps: Mix the beans with the taco seasoning and spread in a dish.
Layer on the sour cream, guacamole, salsa, cheese, tomatoes and green onions.
Chill and serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: French Onion Dip
steps: Cook the onions in the butter over low heat for 25 to 30 minutes until deep golden.
Cool, then mix with the sour cream, cream cheese and worcestershire.
Season and chill.

recipes.title: Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil
steps: Toast the bread slices and rub with the cut garlic.
Mix the tomatoes, basil, oil and salt.
Spoon onto the toasts just before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Brie with Honey and Walnuts
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Bake the brie on a lined tray for 12 to 15 minutes until soft.
Top with honey, walnuts and thyme and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Spiced Candied Nuts
steps: Heat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F).
Whisk the egg white until frothy and toss with the nuts, then the sugar and spices.
Spread on a lined tray and bake for 20 minutes, stirring once; cool to crisp.

recipes.title: Stovetop Popcorn with Parmesan
steps: Heat the oil with 3 kernels in a large covered pot until they pop.
Add the rest, cover and shake over medium heat until popping slows.
Toss with butter, parmesan and salt.

recipes.title: Energy Balls with Oats and Dates
steps: Blend the dates to a paste.
Add the rest and pulse until it holds together.
Roll into 16 balls and chill.

recipes.title: Cucumber Bites with Herbed Cream Cheese
steps: Mix the cream cheese with the herbs and lemon zest.
Pipe or spoon onto the cucumber slices.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Poppers
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Mix the cream cheese and cheddar and fill the jalapeno halves.
Wrap each with bacon and bake for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Blinis
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, egg and milk to a thick batter.
Cook small spoonfuls in a buttered pan for 1 minute per side.
Top with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill.

recipes.title: Guacamole with Toasted Pepitas
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, jalapeno and cilantro.
Top with the pepitas.

recipes.title: Edamame with Chili Garlic Salt
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 to 5 minutes and drain.
Toss with the sesame oil, garlic, chili and salt.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Brush the pastry with egg, scatter with cheese and cayenne, fold and roll lightly.
Cut into strips, twist and bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Tzatziki Veggie Platter
steps: Spoon the tzatziki into a bowl.
Arrange the vegetables and pita around it.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Fries (Oven)
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the sweet potatoes with the cornstarch, then the oil and paprika.
Spread out well and roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once; salt while hot.

recipes.title: Chickpea Tikka Masala
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then blend if you like it smooth.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes; finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Roast the vegetables with the oil and salt at 220 °C (425 °F) for 25 minutes and stir into the marinara.
Layer sauce, lasagna sheets, ricotta and mozzarella three times, ending with sauce and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes, uncover for 15 minutes and rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushroom Stroganoff
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter in batches, then cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika and stock and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the sour cream and mustard off the heat and serve over the noodles with parsley.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice and Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Mix the rice, beans, corn, salsa, cumin and half the cheese and fill the peppers.
Stand them in a dish with 4 tbsp water, cover and bake 30 minutes, then uncover, add the cheese and bake 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, half the parmesan, nutmeg and salt and pipe into the tubes.
Lay on half the sauce, cover with the rest, top with cheeses and bake covered 25 minutes, then uncovered 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Steaks with Romesco

ingredients.name: Cauliflower heads, cut into thick slices

steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Brush the cauliflower slices with the oil, paprika and salt and sear in a hot pan for 2 minutes per side.
Roast for 18 to 20 minutes until tender and serve on romesco with parsley.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Vegetable Skewers
steps: Thread the halloumi and vegetables onto skewers.
Brush with the oil and oregano.
Grill or griddle for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Tofu Katsu
steps: Coat the tofu in flour, egg and panko.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and drain.
Slice and serve with rice, cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Buddha Traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the sweet potato, chickpeas and onion with the oil, spices and salt and roast for 30 minutes.
Toss with the spinach to wilt and drizzle with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bourguignon
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Cook the onions, carrots and garlic for 5 minutes, then the tomato paste and flour for 1 minute.
Add the wine, stock, thyme and mushrooms and simmer 30 minutes until glossy; serve with mash.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu with Mushrooms
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned, then the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock, soy and tofu and simmer gently 5 minutes.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water and finish with the peppercorns and green onions.

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup with Tofu
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, stock, soy, tofu and mushrooms and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the bok choy for 2 minutes, then pour over the cooked noodles with lime and basil.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters with Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix the zucchini, eggs, flour, feta, onions, dill and pepper.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with the yogurt mixed with garlic and salt.

recipes.title: Moroccan Vegetable Tagine
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then the spices for 1 minute.
Add the vegetables except the zucchini, chickpeas, tomatoes, apricots and stock and simmer covered 25 minutes.
Add the zucchini for 10 minutes and serve over couscous with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegan Mushroom Lentil Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot and celery and cook in the oil for 10 minutes with the mushrooms.
Add the garlic and tomato paste, then the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer 25 minutes.
Toss with the cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Cheese and Onion Pasties
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes, drain and cool, then mix with the onion, cheese, salt and pepper.
Cut 6 pastry circles, fill, fold and crimp.
Brush with egg and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Korean Tofu Stew (Sundubu Jjigae)
steps: Fry the kimchi, garlic and gochugaru in the sesame oil for 2 minutes.
Add the stock, soy and mushrooms and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon in the tofu in large pieces, crack in the eggs and simmer 3 minutes; top with green onions.

recipes.title: Polenta with Mushroom Ragout
steps: Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and cook, stirring often, for 25 to 30 minutes; finish with parmesan and butter.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, add the garlic and thyme, then the wine and reduce.
Serve the ragout over the polenta.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Mix the sweet potato, beans and cumin.
Spread on half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold.
Toast in a dry pan for 3 minutes per side and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice with Vegetables
steps: Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the carrot and peas in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes, add the rice and fry until hot and slightly crisp.
Add the soy, eggs, green onions and sesame oil and toss.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu with Sweet Chili Glaze
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornstarch and fry in the oil until crisp on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add the sweet chili sauce and soy and toss to glaze.
Finish with lime and green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Lentil and Vegetable Moussaka
steps: Brush the eggplant with oil and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Cook the onion and garlic, add the lentils, tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 15 minutes.
Layer eggplant and lentils in a dish, top with bechamel and parmesan and bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Coconut Chickpea Stew with Kale
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk with 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas.
Stir in the kale until wilted and finish with lime.

recipes.title: Tempeh Bacon BLT
steps: Marinate the tempeh in the soy, maple and paprika for 10 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Build sandwiches with mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato and tempeh.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Leek Pie
steps: Cook the leeks and mushrooms in the butter for 10 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then the milk, thyme and mustard and simmer until thick; season and cool slightly.
Pour into a pie dish, cover with the pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quinoa Stuffed Acorn Squash
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Brush the squash with oil and roast cut-side down for 30 minutes.
Mix the quinoa, cranberries, pecans, apple, spinach and maple syrup, fill the squash and bake 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Vegan Shepherd's Pie with Mushrooms
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and the oat milk.
Cook the chopped onion, carrots and mushrooms in the rest of the oil for 10 minutes, add the tomato paste, soy, lentils, peas and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Top with the mash and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Huevos a la Flamenca
steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil for 10 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes and peas and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the whites set.

recipes.title: Peanut Noodle Stir-Fry with Tofu
steps: Soak or cook the noodles and drain.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, add the vegetables and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, maple and lime with 4 tbsp hot water and toss everything together.

recipes.title: Bean and Cheese Burritos
steps: Mash the beans with the spices and a splash of water in a pan over low heat.
Fill the tortillas with beans, rice, cheese and salsa and roll.
Toast seam-side down in the oiled pan until golden.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
steps: Season and flour the chicken and brown in the oil and 1 tbsp butter for 3 to 4 minutes per side; set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the rest of the butter, add the garlic, then the marsala and reduce by half.
Add the stock and cream, return the chicken and simmer 5 minutes until cooked through (74 °C.
165 °F); finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Rub the chicken with oil, salt, pepper and lemon zest and stuff with the lemons, garlic and thyme.
Roast on the potatoes for 70 to 80 minutes until the thigh reads 74 °C (165 °F).
Rest 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan

ingredients.name: Chicken breasts, halved horizontally and pounded thin

steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Coat the chicken in flour, egg and the breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan, and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Lay in a dish, top with marinara and mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes until bubbling and cooked through; scatter with basil.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Season the chicken with pepper and brown in the oil for 5 minutes per side.
Add the honey, soy, garlic and vinegar and simmer, turning, for 8 to 10 minutes until sticky and cooked through.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate the chicken in the spice, garlic, lemon juice, oil, yogurt and salt for at least 1 hour.
Roast at 220 °C (425 °F) for 25 minutes or grill until charred and cooked through, then slice.
Pile into warm pita with cucumber, tomato and tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay
steps: Marinate the chicken with the soy, spices, sugar and garlic for 1 hour.
Thread onto soaked skewers and grill or griddle for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with satay sauce and cucumber.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken

ingredients.name: Chicken drumsticks, skin removed and slashed

steps: Rub the chicken with lemon juice and salt, then the yogurt mixed with the spices and paste; marinate 4 hours or overnight.
Roast on a rack at 230 °C (450 °F) for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with onion and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend everything except the chicken to a paste (wear gloves for the habaneros).
Rub into the chicken and marinate overnight.
Roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 35 to 40 minutes, or grill over medium heat, until charred and cooked through.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
steps: Brown the bacon, then the seasoned chicken in the fat, and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms and onions in the butter, add the garlic and flour, then the wine, stock and herbs.
Return the chicken and bacon, cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender; reduce the sauce if thin.

recipes.title: Chicken Schnitzel
steps: Season the chicken, then coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry in the hot oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
steps: Marinate the chicken in the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano and salt for 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, onion and tomato.

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in 3 tbsp cornstarch and fry in batches until crisp and cooked through.
Pour off most of the oil and fry the garlic, ginger and chilies for 30 seconds.
Add the soy, hoisin, vinegar, sugar, stock and the remaining cornstarch, simmer until glossy and toss with the chicken and green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Korma
steps: Cook the onion in the ghee for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown lightly, then the almonds, coconut milk and 100 ml water.
Simmer 20 minutes until cooked through, stir in the yogurt off the boil and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Fricassee
steps: Brown the seasoned chicken lightly in the butter without colouring it much, and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes, stir in the flour, then the wine and stock.
Return the chicken and simmer covered 25 minutes, then stir in the cream and tarragon and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
steps: Cover the chicken with water, add the ginger, green onions and salt, bring to a bare simmer and poach 40 to 45 minutes until the thigh reads 74 °C (165 °F); plunge into ice water.
Fry the garlic in the oil, add the rinsed rice and cook it in 450 ml of the poaching broth, covered, for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken and serve with the rice, cucumber, soy and chili sauce, with the broth on the side.

recipes.title: Chicken Yakitori
steps: Simmer the soy, mirin, sugar and sake for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Thread the chicken and green onions onto soaked skewers.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the sauce for the last few minutes, until cooked through.

recipes.title: Spatchcock Chicken with Herbs
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Cut out the backbone with scissors and press the chicken flat.
Rub with the oil, herbs, garlic, lemon zest, salt and pepper and roast skin-side up for 40 to 45 minutes until the thigh reads 74 °C (165 °F); rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Saltimbocca
steps: Lay a sage leaf and prosciutto on each piece of chicken and dust lightly with flour.
Fry prosciutto-side down in the oil for 3 minutes, turn and cook 3 minutes until cooked through.
Add the wine and butter, bubble to a sauce and finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken with Olives and Lemon
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onion for 6 minutes, add the garlic and spices, then the stock and saffron.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer 35 minutes; add the olives and preserved lemon for the last 10 minutes and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Pollo Asado
steps: Blend the juices, achiote, garlic, spices, oil and salt.
Marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours.
Roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 35 to 40 minutes or grill until charred and cooked through.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Sear the beef in the oil in batches over high heat for 1 minute and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes, stir in the flour, then the stock and mustard.
Simmer 3 minutes, return the beef, stir in the sour cream off the heat and serve over the noodles.

recipes.title: Cottage Pie
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, add the onion and carrots for 6 minutes, then the tomato paste, flour, worcestershire and stock; simmer 20 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter, milk and salt.
Spread the beef in a dish, top with mash and cheese and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Wellington
steps: Season and sear the beef all over in the oil, cool and brush with mustard.
Cook the mushrooms in the butter until all the liquid has gone and cool.
Lay the prosciutto on cling film, spread with mushrooms, roll the beef up tightly and chill 30 minutes.
Wrap in pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 35 to 40 minutes for medium-rare (52 °C inside); rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Rendang
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and chilies to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaves and spices and simmer uncovered, stirring now and then, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
When the sauce is almost gone, add the tamarind, sugar and toasted coconut and fry, stirring, until the beef is dark and coated.

recipes.title: Beef Kofta
steps: Mix the beef, squeezed onion, garlic, parsley, spices and salt well.
Shape around skewers into long kebabs.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through (71 °C.
160 °F) and serve with yogurt and pita.

recipes.title: Beef Goulash
steps: Cook the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Off the heat stir in the paprika and caraway, then add the beef, tomato paste and stock.
Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours, add the peppers and potatoes and cook 30 minutes more until tender.

recipes.title: Ropa Vieja
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock with half the onion, covered, for 2 hours until it shreds; shred and keep the broth.
Cook the rest of the onion and the peppers in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, spices, tomato paste and tomatoes.
Add the beef, olives and 250 ml broth and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Season the pork and coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Drain and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork
steps: Rub the pork with the dry rub and leave overnight if you can.
Roast covered at 150 °C (300 °F) for 5 to 6 hours with the vinegar in the pan, until it pulls apart easily (about 95 °C inside).
Shred, toss with the pan juices and barbecue sauce and serve in buns with slaw.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Coat the pork in the egg and 3 tbsp cornstarch and fry in batches until crisp.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and pineapple in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes.
Add the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy, 100 ml water and the remaining cornstarch, simmer until glossy and toss with the pork.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Sauce
steps: Season and sear the pork all over, then roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 15 minutes until 63 °C (145 °F) inside; rest 5 minutes.
Cook the shallot in the pan, add the wine and reduce by half.
Stir in the cream, mustard and thyme, simmer 2 minutes and serve with the sliced pork.

recipes.title: Pork Souvlaki
steps: Marinate the pork in the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano and salt for 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve with pita and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Bangers and Mash with Onion Gravy
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter, milk and salt.
Fry the sausages in the oil for 15 minutes until cooked through and set aside.
Cook the onions in the pan for 15 minutes until soft and brown, stir in the flour, then the stock and worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes; serve over the sausages and mash.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta with Mint Yogurt
steps: Mix the lamb, squeezed onion, garlic, half the mint, spices and salt.
Shape into 12 kebabs around skewers.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes until cooked through and serve with yogurt mixed with the rest of the mint and lemon.

recipes.title: Roast Leg of Lamb with Garlic and Rosemary
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Make small cuts in the lamb and push in the garlic and rosemary, then rub with oil, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Roast for about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours for medium (about 57 °C inside), then rest 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Lamb Tagine with Apricots
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onions for 8 minutes, add the garlic and spices, then the lamb and stock; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add the apricots, chickpeas and honey and simmer 30 minutes more; finish with almonds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Irish Stew
steps: Layer the lamb, potatoes, carrots and onions in a heavy pot, seasoning each layer.
Pour over the stock, add the thyme, cover and simmer very gently for 2 hours until the lamb is tender.
Finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Mint Sauce
steps: Dissolve the sugar in the boiling water, add the mint and vinegar and leave 15 minutes.
Season the chops and sear in the oil over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium.
Rest 3 minutes and serve with the mint sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Empanadas

ingredients.name: Eggs, 2 hard-boiled and chopped plus 1 beaten for brushing

steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, add the beef and spices and brown; cool and stir in the olives and eggs.
Fill each disc, fold and crimp the edges.
Brush with egg and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pastitsio
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta 2 minutes short and toss with half the cheese and 1 egg.
Layer pasta, meat and pasta in a dish, top with the bechamel whisked with the other egg and the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 40 minutes and rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Lamb Biryani
steps: Marinate the lamb in the yogurt, masala, paste and salt for 2 hours.
Fry the onions in the ghee until deep golden and set half aside; add the lamb and cook covered for 50 minutes until tender.
Par-boil the rice 5 minutes, layer over the lamb with the herbs, fried onions and saffron water, seal and cook on very low heat for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fish and Chips

ingredients.name: White fish fillets, such as cod or haddock

steps: Par-cook the chips in oil at 150 °C for 6 minutes and drain.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sparkling water to a batter, dip the floured fish and fry at 180 °C for 6 to 7 minutes until golden; drain.
Fry the chips again at 180 °C until crisp, salt and serve with lemon; never leave hot oil unattended.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon
steps: Season the salmon and sear skin-side down in the oil for 4 minutes.
Turn, add the butter and garlic and baste for 3 to 4 minutes until just cooked.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Blackened Salmon
steps: Mix the spices with salt and press onto the salmon.
Cook in the butter in a very hot cast-iron pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side until well charred and just cooked.
Serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp with Rice
steps: Toss the shrimp with the flour, paprika and salt.
Cook the garlic in the butter until pale gold, add the shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon and serve over rice with all the garlic butter.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Toss the shrimp with half the cajun seasoning and cook in the butter for 3 minutes; set aside.
Cook the pepper and garlic for 3 minutes, add the cream, rest of the seasoning and parmesan and simmer 2 minutes; toss with the pasta, shrimp and green onions.

recipes.title: Tuna Patties
steps: Mix everything except the oil and shape 8 patties.
Chill for 15 minutes so they hold together.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes with Dill Sauce
steps: Mix the salmon, egg, panko, mayonnaise, mustard and green onions and shape 8 cakes.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the yogurt mixed with dill, lemon and salt.

recipes.title: Maryland Crab Cakes
steps: Gently mix the crab with the egg, mayonnaise, mustard, seafood seasoning, crackers and parsley.
Shape 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes.
Fry in the butter for 3 to 4 minutes per side and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Creamy Fish Pie
steps: Poach the fish in the milk for 5 minutes, lift out and flake; keep the milk.
Make a sauce with the butter, flour and poaching milk, add the peas, parsley, eggs and fish and pour into a dish.
Top with buttery mashed potatoes and cheese and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cod with Chorizo and Chickpeas
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil until it releases its oil, add the garlic, paprika, tomatoes and chickpeas and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.
Nestle in the seasoned cod, cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes until it flakes.

recipes.title: Mussels in White Wine (Moules Marinieres)
steps: Discard any mussels that stay open when tapped.
Cook the shallots and garlic in the butter for 3 minutes, add the wine and bring to the boil.
Add the mussels, cover and steam 4 to 5 minutes, shaking, until opened (discard any that stay shut); stir in the cream and parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Seafood Paella
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil in a paella pan for 6 minutes, add the garlic, paprika and tomato for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then the hot stock and saffron; spread out and simmer without stirring for 10 minutes.
Arrange the seafood and peas on top and cook 8 to 10 minutes until the rice is done and the mussels open.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Season and lightly flour the fish and cook in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until just opaque.
Remove, add the butter to the pan and cook until foaming and golden.
Add the capers, lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the fish.

recipes.title: Parmesan Crusted Tilapia
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Brush the fish with mayonnaise and press on the parmesan, panko and paprika.
Bake on a lined tray for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Steamed Sea Bass with Ginger and Soy
steps: Steam the fish on a plate over boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes until it flakes.
Scatter with the ginger, green onions and cilantro and pour over the soy mixed with the sugar.
Heat the oil until smoking and pour it over the herbs so they sizzle.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Scallops with Lemon Butter
steps: Season the scallops and sear in the very hot oil for 2 minutes without moving.
Turn, add the butter and garlic and baste for 1 minute.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley and serve at once.

recipes.title: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Toss the fish with the soy, sesame oil and vinegar and chill 10 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the fish, avocado, cucumber, edamame, green onions and sesame; use only fish sold for eating raw.

recipes.title: Shrimp Ceviche
steps: Blanch the shrimp for 1 minute, chill and chop.
Cover with the lime juice and leave 20 minutes in the fridge.
Mix in the vegetables, cilantro and salt and top with avocado; serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Kedgeree
steps: Poach the haddock in water for 5 minutes and flake; use the water to cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the butter for 6 minutes and add the curry powder.
Fold in the rice and fish, top with halved eggs and parsley and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Cioppino
steps: Cook the onion and fennel in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and pepper flakes.
Add the wine, tomatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the fish, shrimp and mussels, cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the mussels open; finish with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Salmon en Papillote
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Lay each fillet on a sheet of parchment with the vegetables, lemon, dill, butter, wine and salt.
Fold and crimp tightly into parcels and bake for 12 to 15 minutes; open at the table.

recipes.title: Sardines on Toast with Tomatoes
steps: Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Top with tomato and the sardines.
Finish with lemon, parsley and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Bouillabaisse-Style Fish Stew
steps: Cook the onion, leek and fennel in the oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, saffron and orange zest.
Add the stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the fish and mussels and simmer 6 to 8 minutes; serve with toasts spread with aioli.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate and cool slightly, then stir in the yolks.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Whisk the whites with the salt and sugar to soft peaks and fold in gently.
Spoon into glasses and chill 3 hours; it contains raw egg.

recipes.title: Lemon Mousse
steps: Whisk the condensed milk with the lemon juice and zest until it thickens.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Spoon into glasses and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bark with Nuts and Fruit
steps: Melt the chocolate gently.
Spread thinly on a parchment-lined tray.
Scatter with the nuts, cranberries and salt, chill until set and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Melt the peanut butter and butter together.
Stir in the powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Press into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin, chill 2 hours and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Classic Pavlova
steps: Heat the oven to 120 °C (250 °F).
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy; fold in the vinegar and cornstarch.
Spread into a 20 cm round on parchment and bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours; cool in the oven.
Top with whipped cream and fruit just before serving.

recipes.title: Key Lime Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Press the crumbs, butter and sugar into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime juice and zest, pour over and bake 15 to 18 minutes until set.
Cool and chill 3 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Baked Apples with Oats and Cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Mix the oats, sugar, butter, cinnamon and raisins and pack into the apples.
Stand in a dish with the juice and bake 30 to 35 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sorbet
steps: Dissolve the sugar in the water over heat and cool.
Blend with the strawberries and lemon juice and strain.
Churn in an ice-cream machine, or freeze in a tub and stir with a fork every 45 minutes for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the cocoa, maple syrup and vanilla into the milk.
Stir in the chia, wait 10 minutes and whisk again.
Chill overnight and serve with fruit.

recipes.title: Meringue Kisses
steps: Heat the oven to 100 °C (210 °F).
Whisk the whites and cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add the sugar gradually until stiff and glossy; add the vanilla.
Pipe small kisses onto parchment and bake 1 hour, then cool in the oven.

recipes.title: Almond Biscotti
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Mix the dry ingredients, add the eggs and extract, then the almonds, to a sticky dough.
Shape two logs and bake 25 minutes; cool 10 minutes, slice diagonally and bake the slices 10 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cobbler
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Toss the berries with half the sugar, lemon and cornstarch in a dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder, salt and the rest of the sugar, stir in the buttermilk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Toss the peaches with the sugar and cornstarch in a dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, butter and cinnamon to a crumble and scatter over.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Vanilla Custard
steps: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornstarch, pour on the hot milk while whisking and return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it coats a spoon; add the vanilla.

recipes.title: Cannoli Dip
steps: Beat the ricotta, mascarpone, sugar, vanilla and zest until smooth.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Chill and serve with broken waffle cones or biscuits.

recipes.title: S'mores Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Press the crumbs, butter and sugar into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin and bake 10 minutes.
Scatter with chocolate and marshmallows and bake 8 to 10 minutes until puffed; cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Crispy Rice Cereal Treats
steps: Melt the butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring.
Stir in the vanilla and cereal until coated.
Press into a buttered tin, cool and cut.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun
steps: Simmer the sugar, water and cardamom 5 minutes and add the rose water.
Mix the milk powder, flour, soda, ghee and milk to a soft dough and roll 16 smooth balls.
Fry gently at about 150 °C, turning, for 6 to 8 minutes until deep brown.
Soak in the warm syrup for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kheer (Indian Rice Pudding)
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer in the milk with the cardamom, stirring often, for 35 to 40 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the sugar and saffron and cook 5 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled with the nuts.

recipes.title: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) springform with crumpled parchment.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then the eggs one at a time, then the cream; sift in the flour and salt.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes until deeply browned with a wobbly centre.
Cool completely, then chill before slicing.

recipes.title: Apple Strudel
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, raisins and lemon juice.
Layer the phyllo, brushing each sheet with butter and scattering with crumbs, spread the apples along one edge and roll up.
Brush with butter and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: French Madeleines
steps: Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, zest and butter and chill the batter 1 hour.
Spoon into buttered madeleine tins and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 9 to 11 minutes until domed.

recipes.title: Crepes Suzette
steps: Melt the butter and sugar in a wide pan until lightly caramel.
Add the orange zest and juice and simmer to a syrup.
Fold the crepes into quarters, warm them in the sauce and add the liqueur if using.

recipes.title: Dorayaki
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar and honey, then the flour, baking powder and water to a thick batter; rest 15 minutes.
Cook 12 small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan over low heat until golden.
Sandwich pairs with the red bean paste.

recipes.title: Brigadeiros
steps: Cook the condensed milk, cocoa and butter over low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 to 15 minutes until it pulls away from the pan.
Cool on a plate.
With buttered hands roll into small balls and coat in sprinkles.

recipes.title: Alfajores
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, add the yolks and vanilla, then the cornstarch, flour and baking powder to a soft dough; chill 30 minutes.
Roll 5 mm thick, cut 30 rounds and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 10 to 12 minutes without browning.
Sandwich with dulce de leche and roll the edges in coconut.

recipes.title: Portuguese Custard Tarts
steps: Heat the oven to its hottest, 250 °C (480 °F) or more.
Roll the pastry into a log, cut 12 slices and press each into a muffin cup.
Cook the milk, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and lemon peel until thick, cool slightly, remove the peel and stick and whisk in the yolks and vanilla.
Fill the cases and bake 15 to 20 minutes until blistered.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line two 23 cm (9-inch) tins.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, oil, bananas, pineapple and pecans.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, cool and sandwich and top with the frosting.

recipes.title: Marble Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and butter a loaf or bundt tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, baking powder, milk and vanilla.
Stir the cocoa and 2 tbsp milk into a third of the batter; layer the batters and swirl with a knife.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Olive Oil Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale, then the oil, milk and zest.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt and bake 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tahini Halva
steps: Warm the tahini gently.
Boil the sugar and water to 118 °C (245 °F), the soft-ball stage.
Pour the syrup into the tahini with the vanilla and pistachios and stir just until it thickens.
Press into a lined tin and cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Mochi with Sweet Red Bean
steps: Mix the rice flour, sugar and water smooth in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave covered for 1 minute, stir, then 1 minute more and 30 seconds more until translucent.
Turn onto cornstarch, divide into 12, flatten and wrap each round a ball of bean paste.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Almond Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the almond flour, zest and baking powder.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes, cool and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter, whisk in the sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in the almond flour, cocoa and salt and bake 22 to 25 minutes; cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Vegan Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the bananas, oil, sugar, milk and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and walnuts.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Beat the vegan butter and sugars, then the milk and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, soda and salt, then the chips.
Roll 20 balls and bake 10 to 12 minutes; cool on the tray.

recipes.title: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Mix everything to a dough.
Roll 16 balls, press with a fork and bake 9 to 10 minutes; they firm up as they cool (gluten-free if your baking soda and peanut butter are).

recipes.title: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, maple syrup, oil, vanilla and lemon juice, then stir in the almond flour and soda.
Fold in the blueberries and bake 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Stir the vinegar into the milk and leave 5 minutes.
Whisk the dry ingredients, add the milk, oil and vanilla and stir just to combine; fold in the berries.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk in the eggs, milk and butter and rest 5 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Oat Flour Banana Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, maple syrup and oil.
Stir in the oat flour, soda, cinnamon and salt and bake 20 to 22 minutes; use certified gluten-free oat flour if you need them gluten-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Flour Pancakes
steps: Whisk everything except the oil and rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Cook small pancakes in the oil over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side; they are delicate, so flip gently.

recipes.title: Vegan Carrot Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the carrots, oil, milk, vinegar and walnuts.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes and cool.
Beat the vegan cream cheese with the powdered sugar and spread on top.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Press the almond flour, 30 g cornstarch, butter and powdered sugar into the tin and bake 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon and 2 tbsp cornstarch, pour over and bake 20 to 25 minutes until set; chill before cutting.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, oil and sugar.
Fold in the flours, soda, cinnamon and salt and bake 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the chocolate with the oil, then whisk in the sugar, aquafaba and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt and bake 22 to 25 minutes; cool fully before cutting.

recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Mix the almond flour, oats, maple syrup, oil, extract and salt and press two thirds into the tin.
Spread with the jam, crumble over the rest with the almonds and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookie Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla, then stir in the rest.
Press into the tin and bake 22 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Beat the butter and sugars, then the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, xanthan gum (skip if your blend has it), soda and salt, then the chips; chill 30 minutes.
Roll 20 balls and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Oat Flapjacks
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the vegan butter, sugar and syrup, then stir in the oats and salt.
Press into the tin and bake 20 to 25 minutes; cut while warm, then cool in the tin.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and grease a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, buttermilk and butter.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal with Fried Egg
steps: Simmer the oats in the salted water for 5 minutes until creamy.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the edges crisp.
Spoon the oats into bowls, top with the eggs and green onions and drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Tofu Breakfast Tacos
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric, cumin and salt and cook 5 minutes until hot and lightly golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the tofu, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Omelette
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, turmeric, baking powder and salt to a smooth batter and rest 5 minutes.
Stir in the onion, tomato, cilantro and chili.
Pour half into a hot oiled frying pan, cook 3 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes; repeat.

recipes.title: Huevos Divorciados
steps: Warm the beans and the two salsas in separate pans.
Lightly fry the tortillas in the oil and lay two on each plate.
Fry the eggs and set two on each plate.
Spoon green salsa over one egg and red over the other, add beans and crumble over the cheese.

recipes.title: Turkish Eggs with Garlic Yogurt (Cilbir)
steps: Stir the garlic and salt into the yogurt and spread over two plates.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes.
Melt the butter with the aleppo pepper until foaming.
Set the eggs on the yogurt, spoon over the butter, scatter with dill and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito Bowls
steps: Fry the potatoes in the oil with the chili powder and salt over medium heat for 15 minutes, adding the pepper for the last 5.
Warm the beans.
Scramble the eggs softly.
Divide into bowls and top with cheese, salsa and avocado.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the pumpkin, maple syrup and spice and heat through.
Serve topped with pecans.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Croissant Bake
steps: Butter a baking dish and scatter in the croissants, ham and most of the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and pepper, pour over and leave 15 minutes.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 30 to 35 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Cinnamon French Toast Casserole
steps: Put the bread in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, half the sugar, cinnamon and vanilla, pour over and chill at least 1 hour or overnight.
Drizzle with the butter, sprinkle with the remaining sugar and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Egg and Vegetable Breakfast Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the peas in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes, then add the rice and toss over high heat for 4 minutes.
Return the eggs with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Toast with Almond Butter
steps: Cut the sweet potato lengthways into 1 cm slices.
Toast them in a toaster on high for 3 or 4 cycles, or roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 15 minutes, until tender.
Spread with almond butter and top with banana, cinnamon and honey.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Overnight Oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, banana, maple syrup and cinnamon in two jars.
Chill overnight.
Top with walnuts before eating.

recipes.title: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the tomatoes and cucumber.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with seasoning and pepper.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka
steps: Soften the leek and zucchini in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, kale and spinach and cook until wilted.
Make 6 hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes.
Crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Spinach and Cheese Breakfast Strata
steps: Layer the bread, spinach and cheese in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and salt and pour over; chill at least 2 hours.
Bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 45 to 50 minutes until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Kaya Toast with Soft Eggs
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water, turn off the heat, cover and leave 6 minutes.
Toast the bread, spread with kaya and sandwich with thin slices of butter.
Crack the eggs into bowls and season with soy sauce and pepper to dip.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji (Indian Scrambled Eggs)
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, then add the chili, tomato, turmeric and salt and cook 3 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs and stir over low heat until softly set.
Finish with garam masala and cilantro and serve with flatbread or toast.

recipes.title: Tamago Kake Gohan (Egg over Rice)
steps: Put the steaming rice in a bowl and make a well.
Crack in the egg, add the soy sauce and stir quickly so the heat of the rice lightly cooks the egg.
Top with green onion and furikake; use only very fresh, high-quality eggs as the egg stays partly raw.

recipes.title: Rava Upma
steps: Toast the semolina in a dry pan until fragrant and set aside.
Fry the mustard seeds, dal and curry leaves in the ghee until they crackle, then the onion, chili and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil, then rain in the semolina while stirring and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Cover off the heat for 2 minutes and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Migas
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in the oil until crisp and set aside.
Soften the onion and jalapeno 3 minutes, add the tomato.
Add the beaten eggs and the strips and stir until softly set.
Top with the cheese.

recipes.title: Onion Uttapam
steps: Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over medium heat.
Spread a ladle of batter into a thick 15 cm round.
Scatter with onion, tomato, chili and cilantro and press in lightly.
Drizzle with oil, cook 3 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes; repeat.

recipes.title: Broccoli Crunch Salad with Bacon
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar and honey.
Toss with the broccoli, onion, cranberries and seeds.
Chill 30 minutes and top with the bacon.

recipes.title: Japanese Cucumber Sunomono
steps: Toss the cucumber with the salt, leave 10 minutes and squeeze dry.
Stir the vinegar, sugar and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Toss with the cucumber and wakame and sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.title: Endive, Pear and Blue Cheese Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, honey and salt.
Arrange the endive and pear on a platter.
Scatter with crumbled cheese and walnuts and drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Kale Salad
steps: Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas with 2 tbsp oil and salt at 210 °C (410 °F) for 25 minutes.
Massage the kale with the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup and water to a pourable dressing.
Toss everything together and scatter with seeds.

recipes.title: Carrot Ginger Sesame Salad
steps: Whisk the ginger, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and honey.
Toss with the carrots.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Classic Tuna Salad
steps: Flake the tuna into a bowl.
Mix in the mayonnaise, celery, onion, lemon, relish and pepper.
Serve on lettuce, crackers or in sandwiches.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Salad
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes and beans between bowls.
Top with the beef, cheese and broken chips.
Thin the sour cream with the salsa and spoon over.

recipes.title: Corn and Tomato Salad with Basil
steps: Blanch the corn kernels for 2 minutes and cool, or use raw if very fresh.
Toss with the tomatoes, onion, oil, vinegar and salt.
Tear in the basil just before serving.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Dressing
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, lift out and keep 3 tbsp of the fat in the pan.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard and sugar into the warm fat.
Toss the spinach, mushrooms and onion with the warm dressing and top with bacon and sliced egg.

recipes.title: Grilled Halloumi and Watermelon Salad
steps: Grill or fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss the watermelon, cucumber and mint with the oil and lime juice.
Top with the warm halloumi.

recipes.title: Burrata with Heirloom Tomatoes
steps: Arrange the tomatoes on a platter and season with salt.
Set the burrata in the middle and tear it open.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic and scatter with basil; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, mustard and salt.
Toss with the shaved sprouts and leave 10 minutes to soften.
Add the parmesan, almonds and cranberries.

recipes.title: Celery, Apple and Walnut Salad
steps: Toss the celery and apple with the lemon juice straight away so the apple stays pale.
Add the oil, salt, parsley and walnuts.
Top with the parmesan.

recipes.title: Radish and Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps: Stir the garlic, lemon and salt into the yogurt.
Fold in the radishes and cucumber.
Scatter with dill and serve cold.

recipes.title: Asparagus and Egg Salad
steps: Boil the eggs 9 minutes, cool and chop.
Blanch the asparagus 2 to 3 minutes and cool in iced water.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Arrange the asparagus, scatter with egg, capers and chives and dress.

recipes.title: Quinoa Kale Salad with Lemon
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 400 ml salted water for 15 minutes; cool.
Massage the kale with 1 tbsp oil and salt.
Toss everything with the rest of the oil and the lemon juice and zest.

recipes.title: Chopped Antipasto Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
Chop everything into small even pieces.
Toss with the dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel and Potato Salad
